issues: Babel transformation fails: Jest test runner aborts with a missing Babel plugin error ("Make sure that all the Babel plugins and presets you are using are defined as dependencies"). This stops all tests from running, causing 19 test suites to fail. You need to add the missing Babel plugin/preset to package.json (or adjust babel.config.js) so that Jest can transform the code.

TypeScript compilation errors remain: src/lib/crypto.ts still references Node globals (crypto, Buffer, module) without the appropriate @types/node definitions. Add @types/node as a devDependency and include "node" in the "types" field of tsconfig.json, or refactor the crypto implementation to avoid Node-specific APIs.
feedback: The implementation introduces new modules (validation, files, backup changes, data reset) but the test suite never runs due to Babel configuration issues and TypeScript type errors. Resolve the Babel plugin error and ensure the crypto module compiles with proper type definitions before the tests can be executed and validation logic verified.
